usdRate.sourceName: Banque Centrale du Congo, indicative exchange rate USD/CDF (weekly statistical bulletin no. 39-2026)
usdRate.note: 2,270.47 francs per dollar on 25 September 2026; the BCC site shows 2,265.16 at the start of November 2026. World Bank 2025 average 2,693 (the franc appreciated in 2025-2026). CLDR gives no narrow symbol; 'FC' is the local abbreviation.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Banque Centrale du Congo, national consumer price inflation (INS data), year on year
inflation_cpi.note: National CPI up 8.92% year on year in the 5th week of October 2026 (8.87% the week before); the rise partly reflects falling prices in late 2025 when the franc appreciated.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCC condensé statistique: INS end-of-period inflation 2021-2025 (5.3%, 13.1%, 23.8%, 11.7%, 2.3%); latest 8.9%
inflation_projection.note: The 5-year average is about 11% but has been falling since 2023 and the latest reading is 8.9%, so 9% is a rounded long-run planning rate; no published numeric target was confirmed.

policy_rate.sourceName: Banque Centrale du Congo, taux directeur
policy_rate.note: Policy rate 12.5% since July 2026 (25% in December 2024, 17.5% by December 2025, then 15%, 13.5% and 12.5% in 2026); marginal lending facility 16.5%.

savings_account_rate.note: The BCC publishes only an average deposit rate across banks, not a savings-account rate; the economy is largely dollarised (average dollar deposit rate about 4%).

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate by maturity; the BCC publishes only an average deposit rate in francs (8.24% in September 2026).

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate by maturity; the BCC publishes only an average deposit rate in francs (8.24% in September 2026).

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Banque Centrale du Congo, average deposit rate of banks in national currency (créditeur dépôts MN)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate paid on franc deposits, September 2026 (8.59% in August). Dollar deposits average about 4% (BCC weekly bulletin, September 2026).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; government securities are auctioned to banks.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The Treasury auctions 3- and 6-month bills (Bons du Trésor) only occasionally and to banks; the BCC weekly bulletin of September 2026 shows no recent 3-month auction rate. The BCC's own 84-day bills yielded 12.5% in September 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year government bond yield was found; the domestic bond market is very thin.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond yield was found; the domestic bond market is very thin.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Democratic Republic of the Congo, withholding taxes
tax_bank_interest.note: Standard 20% withholding (movable property tax) on interest paid to residents, on the gross amount; the page gives no separate rate for bank deposit interest of individuals (reviewed 21 April 2026).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists for individuals, and no tax rule for one was found.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A deposit guarantee fund (FOGADEC) was created by law, but its cover limit per depositor could not be read from an official source; its site could not be reached.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found; the BCC reports an average franc lending rate of 23.3% (September 2026).

equity_return_low.sourceName: No stock exchange in DR Congo; global equities in franc terms
equity_return_low.note: No local stock market exists, so equity means a global index fund in franc terms; low case is a weak decade for world shares with little currency gain.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity in US dollars (about 6%) plus assumed franc depreciation; BCC average deposit rate 8.24%
equity_return_base.note: Base case is a global index fund in franc terms, kept within about 3 points of the assumed after-tax safe rate of 6.5% because there is no local index and access is through foreign funds.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity in US dollars plus franc depreciation
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong world equity returns plus faster franc depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Franc per dollar: BCC indicative rate 2,270 (September 2026) vs about 2,850 in late 2024
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a stable or appreciating franc, as in 2025-2026.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Long-run dollar gold trend about 4% plus assumed franc depreciation of about 4%
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold trend plus a franc that loses value against the dollar over time at roughly the inflation gap.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold years and a weaker franc.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCC average deposit rate in francs 8.24% (September 2026); dollar deposits about 4%
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary savings or dollar deposits paying about 4%.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCC average deposit rate in francs 8.24% (September 2026); 20% withholding on interest (PwC)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: franc term deposits at the published average rate (8.24%) less the 20% withholding tax on interest, about 6.6%.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BCC average deposit rate in francs and BCC bill yields (12.5% at 84 days)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer franc deposits near the policy rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The regulator's 2024 market report (ARCA, État du marché 2024) gives premiums and claims by branch but no industry claim settlement ratio for life insurance.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Death-cover contracts exist (ARCA 2024 market report), mostly as group and loan cover, but no published individual term-life premium rates per CDF 1,000 were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found; health cover is sold mostly to employers.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), DR Congo
oop_health_share.note: 38.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025 but the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI series was confirmed; medical costs are planned 2 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI series was confirmed; school costs are planned 1 point above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), DR Congo
life_expectancy.note: 62.1 years in 2024 (men 60.0, women 64.2); older than 2025 but the latest World Bank year. UN WPP 2024 gives 62.4 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; the both-sexes figure at 65 is published, the others are the mean of men and women.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.05 (2025, World Bank), 5.9 (2040) and 7.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/democratic-republic-of-the-congo/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), pension branch
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension from 60 for men and women with at least 180 months of insurance (same for people born after 1975); early pension from 55 reduced 5% per year; at 65 the insured person is retired automatically.

retirement_age_government.note: The civil-service retirement age (statute of public servants) could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCC average deposit rates: francs 8.24%, dollars about 4% (2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly dollar or savings deposits after any tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCC average deposit rate in francs 8.24% (September 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the after-tax franc deposit rate (8.24% less the 20% withholding on interest is about 6.6%).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BCC average deposit rate in francs and BCC bill yields
retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer franc deposits at better rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate assumption 6.5%; global equity low 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits with weak equity and gold years.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate 6.5%, global equity base 9.5%, gold base 8% (franc terms)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of franc deposits, gold and global equity funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix in a weaker-franc decade.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension was found; the CNSS pays only contributory pensions.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension rules were found.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provisions on end-of-service or retirement indemnity could not be read from an official source; any end-of-career payment is set by collective agreements.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), pension branch
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory for salaried workers (5% employee and 5% employer contribution, PwC Tax Summaries 2026); pension from 60 with 180 months of insurance, else a single lump sum. The CNSS page says nothing about indexation, so inflationLinked is set to false (no automatic indexation confirmed).

fdr_3m.note: Offered in francs and US dollars; no published rate by maturity.

fdr_1y.note: Offered in francs and US dollars; no published rate by maturity.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury bills are auctioned to banks only, and 3-month issues have been rare since 2024.

tbond_5y.note: No 5-year government bond for retail investors was found.

tbond_10y.note: No 10-year government bond for retail investors was found.

equity_fund.note: DR Congo has no stock exchange and no locally sold equity fund was found.

gold.note: Gold is sold mostly as jewellery; artisanal gold trading is regulated.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of the Congo (Banque Centrale du Congo, BCC)

insuranceRegulator.name: Insurance Regulatory and Control Authority (Autorité de Régulation et de Contrôle des Assurances, ARCA)

insuranceComplaints.name: ARCA contact page (insurance supervisor)
insuranceComplaints.note: No dedicated complaints desk or ombudsman was found; contact the regulator.

pensionScheme.name: National Social Security Fund (Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale, CNSS), pension branch

statistics.name: Central Bank of the Congo, inflation statistics (INS data)
statistics.note: The National Institute of Statistics (INS) site could not be reached; the BCC republishes its price data.
